falsifier: Refuted if the purged walk-forward out-of-sample CAGR over 2019-01-01..2026-09-24 is less than 2.0 percentage points above the plain BTC/ETH ensemble on the same window, or if its max drawdown is more than 2.0 percentage points deeper than the plain ensemble's

baselines.note: strategy_baseline is the plain BTC/ETH 15-member trend ensemble, OOS window 2019-01-01..2026-09-24, 15 bps/side

both_directions.gave_up: CAGR 40.89% vs plain 49.33% (-8.44pp); fee drag 2.14%/yr vs 1.36%/yr

statement: Scaling each leg of the BTC/ETH trend ensemble by clip(target_vol / sigma_hat, 0, cap), with the shipped HAR+DVOL sigma_hat (7-day forward vol forecast) and the book gross capped at 1, predicts a higher out-of-sample CAGR than the equal-exposure ensemble at a 1d horizon with no deeper max drawdown
